title: Segfault in openldap while using ldaps
body:

### I did this
`curl -k --cert-type P12 --cert mycert.p12:password  'ldaps://localhost/?supportedSASLMechanisms?base?(objectclass=*)'`
After correct output, curl segfaults while in `ldap_unbind_ext` called by `ldap_disconnect`.
This is the `ldapsb_tls` problem we shortly discussed at https://github.com/curl/curl/pull/6518#issuecomment-766784037 and is related to the `conn->data` removal.
### I expected the following
Clean termination

### curl/libcurl version
